

// package main




fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        
let inferred = (
|value: i32| {
  
    

return value + 1;



  
}
)(3)
;


let empty = (
|value: i32| {
  
    

return value + 2;



  
}
)(5)
;


let explicit = (
|left: i32, right: i32| -> (i32) {
  
    

return left + right;



  
}
)(6, 7)
;


let record = (
|| {
  
    

return 42;



  
}
)()
;



assert_eq!((inferred, empty, explicit, record), (4, 7, 13, 42));



    
}
